source.zh: 堅之敗也，堅與張夫人相失，慕容垂將護致之，德正色謂垂曰：「昔楚莊滅陳，納巫臣之諫而棄夏姬。
source.en: When Jian was defeated, he and Consort Zhang lost each other. Murong Chui was about to escort her back, but De, with a stern expression, said to Chui: “When King Zhuang of Chu destroyed Chen, he accepted Wu Chen’s remonstrance and cast aside Xia Ji.

source.zh: 遂以謨從至漢城陽景王廟，宴庶老于申池，北登社首山，東望鼎足，因目牛山而歎曰：「古無不死！」
source.en: Thereupon he took Yan Mo along to the temple of Han Prince Jing of Chengyang, feasted the common elders at Shen Pool, climbed north Mount Sheshou, looked east at the tripod legs of terrain, then gazed at Mount Niu and sighed, saying, 'From antiquity there has been no not dying!'

source.zh: 邃答曰：「武王封比干之墓，漢祖祭信陵之墳，皆留心賢哲，每懷往事。
source.en: Sui replied, 'King Wu of Zhou raised a mound over Bi Gan's tomb, Han's Gaozu sacrificed at Lord Xinling's grave—both fixed their hearts on worthies and often cherished old deeds.
